header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the appellant nor any intimation received. Even
body: on the last date of hearing, the intimation notice was ordered to be issued to the counsel for appellant, but despite of that none has appeared on behalf of the appellant today, which reflects that appellant has lost his interest to proceed with this appeal.
Under these circumstances, this appeal is dismissed for nonprosecution.
